classification.difficultyReason: Explain the equal angles algebraically using the triangle angle sum.

content.prompt: Use algebra to explain why every angle in an equilateral triangle is $60^{\circ}$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6: upright triangle below the prompt, toward the right.
spec.description: Equilateral triangle with horizontal base and an italic x inside each vertex; no ticks, arcs or shading.
spec.mathematics: All three interior angles are equal and labelled x.
spec.answerVisibility: The three x labels are permanent student-visible givens. Numerical answers are excluded.

answer.short: The three angles are equal, so $3x=180^{\circ}$ and $x=60^{\circ}$.
answer.worked:
An equilateral triangle has three equal angles. Let each angle be $x^{\circ}$. Using the angle sum of a triangle:
$$\begin{align*}x+x+x&=180\\3x&=180\\x&=60\end{align*}$$
Every angle is $60^{\circ}$.
